description: This Java class defines a REST controller for admin gallery operations in a Spring-based backend. It provides endpoints for listing gallery images, uploading new images, and deleting images, all protected by admin authorization.

classes.name: AdminGalleryController
classes.description: REST controller managing admin operations for gallery images, including listing, uploading, and deleting images.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list recent gallery images, with optional limit parameter.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload an image file along with optional alt text, validating file type.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an image by ID, via the service.
